basic_info.description: Set along the scenic San Francisco waterfront, the Dogpatch neighborhood masterfully blends historic character with modern creativity. Once an industrial hub filled with warehouses, Dogpatch has reinvented itself as a lively enclave of art, culture, and culinary delights. Stroll through walkable streets lined with local breweries, artisan boutiques, and trendsetting restaurants. Discover vibrant murals, sip craft brews by the bay, or indulge in farm-to-table cuisineDogpatch delivers a uniquely San Francisco experience.    In the heart of the historic Potrero Square, you'll find a beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom loft that captures the essence of modern living with a touch of industrial flair. This expansive home features soaring ceilings, exposed brick, and an open-concept layout that blends comfort with contemporary style. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and ample cabinetry, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Both bedrooms offer generous space, with the primary suite boasting a private ensuite bath. Just steps away, Esprit Park offers a peaceful green retreat, ideal for relaxing or staying active.    Live where heritage meets innovation in one of San Francisco's most distinctive and desirable neighborhoods.
